name: scope-authority-claim-story
title: Send story-scoped Authority job claims from the CLI live runner
description: The Authority Server now supports signed storyId/jobId selectors so a runner does not lease stale queued jobs from discarded or unrelated stories. The CLI live runner still sends broad signed claims in its live paths, which can reproduce claimed-job-story-mismatch when old queued jobs remain on the server. This story wires the expected story identity into claim payloads and covers the behavior with focused smokes.
